briar.thomas.first.speaker: thomas
briar.thomas.first.text: The Legion has reached our fields. You're going to fight, aren't you?

briar.thomas.protect.speaker: thomas
briar.thomas.protect.text: I know. I just wish that someone didn't have to be you. Come here. That strap won't last a minute.

briar.thomas.afraid.speaker: thomas
briar.thomas.afraid.text: Being scared means you're paying attention. Let me fix your strap. Then promise me you'll come back when you need help.

briar.thomas.joke.speaker: thomas
briar.thomas.joke.text: Try standing behind the fence. Makes you look taller. Hold still while I fix this strap.

briar.thomas.ready.speaker: thomas
briar.thomas.ready.text: Go to Mara. She needs help treating the wounded. I'll help our neighbors pack.

briar.mara.first.speaker: mara
briar.mara.first.text: I need tangle roots for fevers and clean dressings for wounds. Help me get these people ready to leave.

briar.mara.why.speaker: mara
briar.mara.why.text: The wounded need treatment before they can fight or escape.

briar.mara.joke.speaker: mara
briar.mara.joke.text: Only if it comes wrapped in clean cloth. And please don't bring it inside.

briar.mara.supplies.speaker: mara
briar.mara.supplies.text: Bring three tangle roots from the garden and clean dressings from the village store. Its front door is open.

briar.mara.wait.speaker: mara
briar.mara.wait.text: Three roots from the garden. Clean dressings from the store.

briar.mara.heal.speaker: mara
briar.mara.heal.text: Thank you. The neighbors can rest now. I found this purple crystal in the fields—take it from my supply table. It may help on your journey. Next, clear the mill crossing.

briar.mara.next.speaker: mara
briar.mara.next.text: Follow the road to the mill. Its pressure plate shuts the water feed. Keep it down while you free the jammed wheel.

briar.gus.first.speaker: gus
briar.gus.first.text: My tools are in the loft. I can't climb up while the Legion is outside.

briar.gus.home.speaker: gus
briar.gus.home.text: These are my neighbors. I'm staying to help.

briar.gus.request.speaker: gus
briar.gus.request.text: Bring my tool roll from the loft window. I'll open the workshop shortcut and give you a purple shard.

briar.gus.waiting.speaker: gus
briar.gus.waiting.text: The tool roll is by the loft window.

briar.gus.thanks.speaker: gus
briar.gus.thanks.text: Thanks. Take this shard. The workshop shortcut is open if the street gets dangerous.

briar.gus.done.speaker: gus
briar.gus.done.text: Door's open. Watch the low beam. It has won every argument I've had with it.

briar.gus.hurt.speaker: gus
briar.gus.hurt.text: I'm scared. They knocked our village sign into the mud. Please don't make this worse.

briar.gus.sorry.speaker: gus
briar.gus.sorry.text: All right. Give me a moment. Seeing our village name in the dirt hurt.

briar.gus.repair.speaker: gus
briar.gus.repair.text: You fixed the sign. Thank you. Fetch my tools and I'll help with the door.

briar.gus.closed.speaker: gus
briar.gus.closed.text: Go. I'll find someone else to help. I've got enough trouble outside my door.

briar.lewis.first.speaker: lewis
briar.lewis.first.text: Their signal post is ahead. Silence the horn before it brings patrols to our neighbors.

briar.lewis.routes.speaker: lewis
briar.lewis.routes.text: Go through the camp or climb the roots on the right. Stop the crank below the horn, or cut its cable from above.

briar.lewis.prisoners.speaker: lewis
briar.lewis.prisoners.text: They took prisoners north toward Hollow Pass. The guards know their names, but show no mercy.

briar.lewis.waiting.speaker: lewis
briar.lewis.waiting.text: Silence the horn, then reach the north clearing. I'll watch the neighbors.

briar.lewis.clear.speaker: lewis
briar.lewis.clear.text: The horn is quiet. Our neighbors are safe here, but something large blocks the way ahead.

briar.beth.first.speaker: beth
briar.beth.first.text: My brother followed our sheep across the bridge. It broke. He's trapped beyond those beasts.

briar.beth.sheep.speaker: beth
briar.beth.sheep.text: Those sheep are our food and wool. He was trying to save them.

briar.beth.trail.speaker: beth
briar.beth.trail.text: Follow his crooked heel prints east. Cross the remaining bridge beams; there's a lower dry path if you slip.

briar.beth.relief.speaker: beth
briar.beth.relief.text: He's safe! Once we leave the woods, our dog can travel with you.

briar.bethBrother.first.speaker: bethBrother
briar.bethBrother.first.text: The fallen tree could roll. Clear the beasts, then use the rope lift to raise it.

briar.bethBrother.wait.speaker: bethBrother
briar.bethBrother.wait.text: I can walk once the path is clear.

briar.bethBrother.safe.speaker: bethBrother
briar.bethBrother.safe.text: The tree's up and the crossing is fixed. I'm heading back. Thank you.

rk.grant.first.speaker: grant
rk.grant.first.text: Clear the arrow post, cut its bow cord, then raise the gate. People are trapped beyond it and in the cells below.

rk.grant.people.speaker: grant
rk.grant.people.text: The Legion seized ordinary workers. Help me get them out.

rk.grant.plan.speaker: grant
rk.grant.plan.text: Ring the breach bell when ready. Stay nearby and defend either gap until everyone crosses. If we retreat, we can try again.

rk.grant.cells.speaker: grant
rk.grant.cells.text: After the rescue, take the lower guard post's jail key or climb east and turn the gate wheel. Either opens the stairs.

rk.grant.safe.speaker: grant
rk.grant.safe.text: Everyone is safe. Search the cells below. The Legion's prisoner records may tell you where the missing people went.

rk.felix.first.speaker: felix
rk.felix.first.text: Recover my tools from the east workshop. I'll open the west chamber and give you a dagger.

rk.felix.plan.speaker: felix
rk.felix.plan.text: Watch the latch's notch. Press when it turns green.

rk.felix.chamber.speaker: felix
rk.felix.chamber.text: The west chamber holds a shield and armed figures. The broken western wall may offer another entrance.

rk.felix.reward.speaker: felix
rk.felix.reward.text: Tools returned. The west chamber is open. Take this dagger—the Lockpick.

rk.felix.done.speaker: felix
rk.felix.done.text: Watch the chamber's guards. Give yourself room if they wake.

cg.roland.hello.speaker: roland
cg.roland.hello.text: Stop. You need a disguise to get through that guarded door.

cg.roland.menu.speaker: roland
cg.roland.menu.text: Bring a supply coat, a sound helmet and crew papers. I'll fit the disguise. You'll still need convincing answers.

cg.roland.fitted.speaker: roland
cg.roland.fitted.text: The disguise covers your gear. Keep your answers short when Cross questions you.

cg.roland.bridge.speaker: roland
cg.roland.bridge.text: Cross the broken drain below the bell post. The brake lowers a walkway back. Then turn the bridge wheel by the bell post.

cg.roland.personal.speaker: roland
cg.roland.personal.text: My chest piece is in the seized goods room, east of the wagon yard. Return it for a reward.

cg.roland.warning.speaker: roland
cg.roland.warning.text: They already tried that voice on me. Do you want to try a different one?

cg.roland.refused.speaker: roland
cg.roland.refused.text: I'll still fit your disguise. But we're done discussing my armor.

cg.roland.kept.speaker: roland
cg.roland.kept.text: Keep it, then. You get no reward for returning it. The disguise is a separate matter.

cg.roland.thanks.speaker: roland
cg.roland.thanks.text: My name is still stamped inside. Thank you. Take this shard from the palace shipment.

cg.cross.check.speaker: cross
cg.cross.check.text: That does not match this delivery. Present the crew papers. One more answer.

cg.cross.pass.speaker: cross
cg.cross.pass.text: Papers accepted. Keep the passage clear. Do not leave the assigned route.

cg.cross.alarm.speaker: cross
cg.cross.alarm.text: False orders. Hold the court. No one passes.

ic.ellis.first.speaker: ellis
ic.ellis.first.text: They caught me and were taking me to the Gate. My sealed notes fell near the west tunnel. Read them when you find the pack.

ic.ellis.press.speaker: ellis
ic.ellis.press.text: I helped with the King's research. My notes show where the Legion gets its weapons.

ic.ellis.wait.speaker: ellis
ic.ellis.wait.text: Brown pack, red seal. Look on the low shelf west of this room.

ic.ellis.motive.speaker: ellis
ic.ellis.motive.text: We wanted to stop aging and disease. That was the work I agreed to.

ic.ellis.truth.speaker: ellis
ic.ellis.truth.text: The Gate stopped aging. But those who returned obeyed every order he gave. We should have stopped the research then.

ic.ellis.guilt.speaker: ellis
ic.ellis.guilt.text: I ignored the warnings. Then my colleagues began obeying him too. I ran. Let me help now.

ic.ellis.lead.speaker: ellis
ic.ellis.lead.text: Emberdeep arms the Legion. Shut its forge down. Three officers guard this cavern's north exit.

ic.ellis.unknown.speaker: ellis
ic.ellis.unknown.text: I don't know how to restore them. Remember: they were people before they were his soldiers.

ic.ellis.water.speaker: ellis
ic.ellis.water.text: The water lifts an old platform. Pump it up to the middle marks, jump over to freeze the channel, then reach the drain on the far bank.

ic.ellis.ready.speaker: ellis
ic.ellis.ready.text: I'll gather my research. It's time I helped instead of hiding.

ic.hugo.first.speaker: hugo
ic.hugo.first.text: I fell through the ice. Can you help me out?

ic.hugo.tease.speaker: hugo
ic.hugo.tease.text: Yes, I saw the warning sign. You can laugh once I'm out.

ic.hugo.wait.speaker: hugo
ic.hugo.wait.text: Find spare rope on the lower eastern path. Secure the wooden frame before lowering it.

ic.hugo.ice.speaker: hugo
ic.hugo.ice.text: There's a sealed chamber below the waterworks and a high ledge above the frozen waterfall.

ic.hugo.thanks.speaker: hugo
ic.hugo.thanks.text: Take this shard. For the side chamber, drain the old water first. Check the plate by the controls.

ic.hugo.home.speaker: hugo
ic.hugo.home.text: I'll wait safely by the waterworks. Somewhere without thin ice.

ic.hugo.safe.speaker: hugo
ic.hugo.safe.text: Both boots on solid ground. I could get used to this.

ic.hugo.remind.speaker: hugo
ic.hugo.remind.text: The chamber is west, below the waterworks. Drain first and follow the marks. The waterfall ledge is east.

ak.king.offer.speaker: abyss_king
ak.king.offer.text: Every healer fights death. I found an answer. You came to destroy it.

ak.king.price.speaker: abyss_king
ak.king.price.text: They will never grow old. You offer them death and call it mercy.

ak.king.recognize.speaker: abyss_king
ak.king.recognize.text: Ian is dead. There has been no Bladeborn since him. How can you stand against me?

ak.king.plunge.speaker: abyss_king
ak.king.plunge.text: Then I will take all the Void's power. I will not lose Aerth to you.

ak.ian.welcome.speaker: ian
ak.ian.welcome.text: You fought before you knew you could win. I've been waiting to meet you.

ak.ian.name.speaker: ian
ak.ian.name.text: I'm Ian's spirit. My life ended peacefully. Yours is beginning. You are Bladeborn.

ak.ian.family.speaker: ian
ak.ian.family.text: Your blood carries an old Bladeborn line. Thomas found you orphaned and raised you as his own. Your courage was always yours.

ak.ian.father.speaker: ian
ak.ian.father.text: Of course Thomas is your father. He raised you, loved you, and helped you become yourself.

ak.ian.souls.speaker: ian
ak.ian.souls.text: The King's control is gone. The binding still traps the souls. We must break it from inside.

ak.ian.blade.speaker: ian
ak.ian.blade.text: Take my blade. Put all your strength into one cut through the binding. Free them.

ak.ian.restored.speaker: ian
ak.ian.restored.text: The souls are returning. Even those whose bodies fell are whole again. You gave them their lives back.

ak.ian.legacy.speaker: ian
ak.ian.legacy.text: One day you'll join the Bladeborn spirits. We learn together and watch over Aerth. For now, go home. Your life awaits.

gf.pike.first.speaker: pike
gf.pike.first.text: Production is interrupted. State your work station and reason for entry. Workers without a task return to the line.

gf.pike.records.speaker: pike
gf.pike.records.text: West maintenance bay. All faults must be checked against the shift schedule. Unsupported claims delay production.

gf.pike.proof.speaker: pike
gf.pike.proof.text: Pressure loss confirmed. Inspection takes priority. Gate patrol: examine the west pipe. Worker passage is cleared for maintenance.

gf.pike.alarm.speaker: pike
gf.pike.alarm.text: Unassigned movement. Gate patrol: stop this worker. Production must continue.

gf.pike.done.speaker: pike
gf.pike.done.text: The schedule does not allow further discussion.

gf.martin.first.speaker: martin
gf.martin.first.text: The weapon line has stopped. Help me get the workers out.

gf.martin.plan.speaker: martin
gf.martin.plan.text: Open the worker passage. I can lead everyone to the break room, but guards will come. Stop the transport chain first if you want fewer patrols on the route.

gf.martin.early.speaker: martin
gf.martin.early.text: Open the west passage, then ring the work bell. Stay with us and keep the guards off the workers.

gf.martin.quiet.speaker: martin
gf.martin.quiet.text: Stop the transport chain on the west loading floor. Then ring the work bell and guard us on the way up.

gf.martin.wait.speaker: martin
gf.martin.wait.text: I am keeping count. Every worker, every time. What have you found?

gf.martin.cool.speaker: martin
gf.martin.cool.text: Stand on the blue cooling pedal. Water flows while you hold it, so watch the gauge and fight from there. Cold water may also weaken the Colossus's heated armor.

gf.martin.office.speaker: martin
gf.martin.office.text: The Legion locks seized papers above the east gallery. Search there.

gf.martin.pages.speaker: martin
gf.martin.pages.text: Sunspire Palace has an orb that answers one question. My Storm Coast contacts can help you reach it once we escape.

gf.martin.hope.speaker: martin
gf.martin.hope.text: You stopped their weapons and rescued us. We'll help you reach Sunspire.

gf.martin.cage.speaker: martin
gf.martin.cage.text: The heat is hurting that creature. Shut its feed at the cage bay. The skitters will come running; clear them, then open the lock.

hp.caleb.first.speaker: caleb
hp.caleb.first.text: I escaped a prisoner wagon. Ruth stayed with the others. Please help me get them out.

hp.caleb.blame.speaker: caleb
hp.caleb.blame.text: I ran. Now I want to help. I can show you the wagon.

hp.caleb.trail.speaker: caleb
hp.caleb.trail.text: Take the lower path past the split rocks. Follow my cloth markers to the wagon below the tall stone arch.

hp.caleb.timing.speaker: caleb
hp.caleb.timing.text: Lower the freight bridge. Reach the lookout by fighting or using the high shelves. Its lift leads to the canyon cages.

hp.caleb.ruth.speaker: caleb
hp.caleb.ruth.text: Ruth kept everyone alive. She'll know which prisoners need help.

hp.caleb.keep.speaker: caleb
hp.caleb.keep.text: They're headed for Ruined Keep. Free them before the next escort leaves. I'll wait for anyone escaping.

hp.skip.first.speaker: skip
hp.skip.first.text: I'm Skip. I climb these cliffs. Watch the edge.

hp.skip.rope.speaker: skip
hp.skip.rope.text: Recover my rope below the broken eastern platform. Use the lower shelf. I'll fix the ridge crossing and give you a spear.

hp.skip.joke.speaker: skip
hp.skip.joke.text: The spear's never fallen off a cliff. Better record than mine.

hp.skip.advice.speaker: skip
hp.skip.advice.text: Drooping cloth means calmer wind. Close the windbreak below to shelter the upper crossing. Look for a purple glint on the ridge.

hp.skip.thanks.speaker: skip
hp.skip.thanks.text: The ridge crossing is ready. Take Cliff Runner, as promised.

hp.skip.ready.speaker: skip
hp.skip.ready.text: The bridge cart sits on the left rail. Roll it onto the floor plate, then release the bridge winch.

hp.skip.brake.speaker: skip
hp.skip.brake.text: I watched the bridge move when the cart hit that plate. Keep clear of the wheels.

hub.quartermaster.intro.speaker: quartermaster
hub.quartermaster.intro.text: I sell equipment and buy spare gear. What do you need?

hub.quartermaster.guide.speaker: quartermaster
hub.quartermaster.guide.text: Compare gear before buying. Check class and level requirements. Sell spares you no longer need.

hub.quartermaster.about.speaker: quartermaster
hub.quartermaster.about.text: I equip the people who can fight. That's how I help.

hub.quartermaster.news.speaker: quartermaster
hub.quartermaster.news.text: Your victories are giving people hope.

hub.anvil.intro.speaker: anvil
hub.anvil.intro.text: Bring spare gear. I'll forge something stronger.

hub.anvil.guide.speaker: anvil
hub.anvil.guide.text: Fuse two matching items of the same rarity. Check the result first: both original items are consumed.

hub.anvil.about.speaker: anvil
hub.anvil.about.text: I used to make hinges. I'd like to do that again.

hub.anvil.news.speaker: anvil
hub.anvil.news.text: People are repairing their homes instead of fleeing. Keep giving them hope.

hub.keeper.intro.speaker: keeper
hub.keeper.intro.text: Choose how you want to look. The wardrobe is ready.

hub.keeper.guide.speaker: keeper
hub.keeper.guide.text: Choose unlocked cosmetics in the wardrobe. Appearance changes do not increase your strength.

hub.keeper.about.speaker: keeper
hub.keeper.about.text: Looking like yourself can help you feel like yourself again.

hub.keeper.news.speaker: keeper
hub.keeper.news.text: Hope suits the people you've helped.

hub.drillmaster.intro.speaker: drillmaster
hub.drillmaster.intro.text: Choose a class, learn its skills, then practice.

hub.drillmaster.guide.speaker: drillmaster
hub.drillmaster.guide.text: Equip unlocked classes here. New disciplines may require trials. Test your skills in the Sparring Room.

hub.drillmaster.about.speaker: drillmaster
hub.drillmaster.about.text: You don't need to be fearless. Pay attention and keep practicing.

hub.drillmaster.news.speaker: drillmaster
hub.drillmaster.news.text: The next enemy may fight differently. Keep learning.

hub.beastkeeper.intro.speaker: beastkeeper
hub.beastkeeper.intro.text: Looking for a companion? Mind your fingers around the hungry ones.

hub.beastkeeper.guide.speaker: beastkeeper
hub.beastkeeper.guide.text: Equip one owned companion in the Pet Yard. Check its abilities, name it, and train it to suit your play style.

hub.beastkeeper.about.speaker: beastkeeper
hub.beastkeeper.about.text: Even a small companion can make a big difference.

hub.beastkeeper.news.speaker: beastkeeper
hub.beastkeeper.news.text: The animals knew you were back before I did.

hub.quartermaster.news.keep.speaker: quartermaster
hub.quartermaster.news.keep.text: The freed prisoners are reaching us. We have more people to feed—and more hands to help.

hub.quartermaster.news.ember.speaker: quartermaster
hub.quartermaster.news.ember.text: The forge is quiet. Now we need tools and roof nails instead of swords.

hub.quartermaster.news.castle.speaker: quartermaster
hub.quartermaster.news.castle.text: People we thought lost are coming home. I've borrowed another table.

hub.anvil.news.keep.speaker: anvil
hub.anvil.news.keep.text: A freed prisoner asked for a door latch. It's good to build something ordinary again.

hub.anvil.news.ember.speaker: anvil
hub.anvil.news.ember.text: You stopped their forge. Let's use what's left to rebuild.

hub.anvil.news.castle.speaker: anvil
hub.anvil.news.castle.text: Windows, gates, cooking pots. Finally, repairs without Legion orders.

hub.keeper.news.keep.speaker: keeper
hub.keeper.news.keep.text: The freed prisoners wanted clothes they chose themselves.

hub.keeper.news.ember.speaker: keeper
hub.keeper.news.ember.text: A worker kept a scrap of colored cloth to remember home. I'll mend it for him.

hub.keeper.news.castle.speaker: keeper
hub.keeper.news.castle.text: What should free people wear? Whatever they like.

hub.drillmaster.news.keep.speaker: drillmaster
hub.drillmaster.news.keep.text: Three more people want training. Yesterday, they wanted somewhere to hide.

hub.drillmaster.news.ember.speaker: drillmaster
hub.drillmaster.news.ember.text: The Legion can replace a sword more easily than its forge. Well done.

hub.drillmaster.news.castle.speaker: drillmaster
hub.drillmaster.news.castle.text: Peace needs protecting. Keep practicing—but take today off.

hub.beastkeeper.news.keep.speaker: beastkeeper
hub.beastkeeper.news.keep.text: A freed prisoner called his dog's name. It recognized him at once.

hub.beastkeeper.news.ember.speaker: beastkeeper
hub.beastkeeper.news.ember.text: Less smoke from Emberdeep helps the animals too.

hub.beastkeeper.news.castle.speaker: beastkeeper
hub.beastkeeper.news.castle.text: The restored animals are recognizing their families. Give them time.

ih.flint.first.speaker: flint
ih.flint.first.text: This forge arms the Legion. Free the workers beside the hammer before touching any valves.

ih.flint.careful.speaker: flint
ih.flint.careful.text: Clear the guards and open the shelter first. Sabotaging loaded machinery could hurt the workers.

ih.flint.plan.speaker: flint
ih.flint.plan.text: Open the shelter west of the workers. Find Jack by the service cart beyond. Take the patrol route or the high walkway.

ih.flint.work.speaker: flint
ih.flint.work.text: Recover my blade blank from the raised store east of the presses. I'll make you a reward.

ih.flint.price.speaker: flint
ih.flint.price.text: Choose a weapon or armor when you return it.

ih.flint.wait.speaker: flint
ih.flint.wait.text: I'll stay here. Find me when you're ready.

ih.flint.remind.speaker: flint
ih.flint.remind.text: Shelter the workers, then repair Jack's cart. In the machine room, push the scrap sled along the track. The floor flashes before the hammer falls. Jam the drive gear to stop the line.

ih.flint.return.speaker: flint
ih.flint.return.text: You found it. Take this shard too. Now choose what I should forge.

ih.flint.reward.speaker: flint
ih.flint.reward.text: Take Forgeguard. Finish Iron Halls to secure what you've earned.

ih.flint.stopped.speaker: flint
ih.flint.stopped.text: The line is stopped. Find Martin and the other workers in the Great Furnace.

ih.jack.first.speaker: jack
ih.jack.first.text: The western stores have insulated brake handles. Fit them to this cart, or bring them to me. Then its deck can bridge the gap.

ih.jack.joke.speaker: jack
ih.jack.joke.text: Exactly. Very reliable at that part. I’m trying to expand its range.

ih.jack.wait.speaker: jack
ih.jack.wait.text: Western stores. Look for thick wrapped grips. Fit them into the cart or bring them to me.

ih.jack.route.speaker: jack
ih.jack.route.text: The floor lights up before each press falls. Cross after it strikes, or take the lower patrol route.

ih.jack.controls.speaker: jack
ih.jack.controls.text: Push the scrap sled from behind. When the hammer warns, stop and let it strike, then push on. The sled jams the drive gear.

ih.jack.fixed.speaker: jack
ih.jack.fixed.text: The cart bridge is ready. Stop the weapon line before crossing. Then the western casting molds will be cool enough to open.

ih.jack.after.speaker: jack
ih.jack.after.text: I'll keep the route clear. You handle the Great Furnace.

la.miles.hello.speaker: miles
la.miles.hello.text: Quiet. The guards count footsteps now. I told them the stairs would win.

la.miles.menu.speaker: miles
la.miles.menu.text: The King is above. My friends are in the cells below him. Please free them.

la.miles.stairs.speaker: miles
la.miles.stairs.text: Release the catches on the first and second great turns. They stay open.

la.miles.workers.speaker: miles
la.miles.workers.text: Clear the guards on the next turn and pull the cell wheel. I'll lead the prisoners through the service passage.

la.miles.safe.speaker: miles
la.miles.safe.text: They're free. I'll guide them out.

la.miles.refuge.speaker: miles
la.miles.refuge.text: We'll help rebuild your village. You've given us a future.

la.miles.vault.speaker: miles
la.miles.vault.text: The worker-cell lock holds the vault cable. Free them, then climb the broken shelves above the linen room to reach its brake.

la.miles.joke.speaker: miles
la.miles.joke.text: They do not sleep. Somehow they still need bedrooms cleaned.

la.miles.refuse.speaker: miles
la.miles.refuse.text: Keep climbing, then. If you change your mind, the cell wheel is still there.

lc.ward.first.speaker: ward
lc.ward.first.text: Holding yard. No visitors. State your work detail.

lc.ward.rules.speaker: ward
lc.ward.rules.text: Orders decide who passes. Check the records desk west of here.

lc.ward.families.speaker: ward
lc.ward.families.text: Families may request transport together. All names must be entered in the record.

lc.ward.pass.speaker: ward
lc.ward.pass.text: Fourth cart. West yard. Shift change. Order matches. The work detail will use the other stairs. Proceed.

lc.ward.done.speaker: ward
lc.ward.done.text: Your assigned path is open. Do not delay the next transport.

lc.ward.fail.speaker: ward
lc.ward.fail.text: No personal orders were received. False authority. Guards: seize the speaker.

lc.ward.locked.speaker: ward
lc.ward.locked.text: Remain where you are. The gate is closed.

lc.ruth.first.speaker: ruth
lc.ruth.first.text: Caleb escaped? Good. Free both cage groups and cut the alarm cable above the east yard. We need both done to escape.

lc.ruth.curt.speaker: ruth
lc.ruth.curt.text: You need the gates open to reach the north crossing. Help with those; I'll help the people.

lc.ruth.plan.speaker: ruth
lc.ruth.plan.text: Cut the east scaffold's alarm cable to stop patrols. Free both groups; protect the north pair as they walk. Then open the escape gate beyond the shelter.

lc.ruth.extra.speaker: ruth
lc.ruth.extra.text: More prisoners are in the old cage on the west shelf. Please rescue them too.

lc.ruth.repair.speaker: ruth
lc.ruth.repair.text: A prisoner needs water. Fill these flasks at the clean spring beyond the loaded wagon.

lc.ruth.water.speaker: ruth
lc.ruth.water.text: Thank you. He needed that water badly.

lc.ruth.reward.speaker: ruth
lc.ruth.reward.text: Everyone's free. Take this Rift Shard as thanks.

lc.ruth.safe.speaker: ruth
lc.ruth.safe.text: We'll wait under cover until the crossing is safe.

lc.ruth.marksman.speaker: ruth
lc.ruth.marksman.text: A Hollowed marksman guards the last crossing. Use cover and alternate paths. Beyond it, follow the records to Ruined Keep.

pc.grace.hello.speaker: grace
pc.grace.hello.text: The Legion holds the palace. Watch the broken tiles.

pc.grace.orb.speaker: grace
pc.grace.orb.text: The orb is beyond the Sky Library's locked doors. Help secure the courtyard first.

pc.grace.water.speaker: grace
pc.grace.water.text: Go down the west steps. Remove the iron clamp, then turn the water wheel.

pc.grace.curt.speaker: grace
pc.grace.curt.text: The wheel supplies our healing station. Open it so we can help the wounded.

pc.grace.wait.speaker: grace
pc.grace.wait.text: West steps: clamp, then wheel. Afterward, find Victor on the next terrace.

pc.grace.restored.speaker: grace
pc.grace.restored.text: This large healing pad won't run out. Smaller pads along the paths have limited healing.

pc.grace.route.speaker: grace
pc.grace.route.text: Find Victor beyond the fountain. He knows the guarded balconies.

pc.grace.garden.speaker: grace
pc.grace.garden.text: Open the east greenhouse's water channel, then bring me the seed tin. We'll grow food again.

pc.grace.garden.curt.speaker: grace
pc.grace.garden.curt.text: Food still matters during an invasion. You can decline without mocking us.

pc.grace.garden.wait.speaker: grace
pc.grace.garden.wait.text: Clear the garden channel and bring the seed tin.

pc.grace.thanks.speaker: grace
pc.grace.thanks.text: Take this Rift Shard and seeds for home. Thank you.

pc.victor.hello.speaker: victor
pc.victor.hello.text: Sergeant Victor. I'm holding what's left of the courtyard watch.

pc.victor.people.speaker: victor
pc.victor.people.text: The workers are safe. The Legion seized the palace for its knowledge.

pc.victor.route.speaker: victor
pc.victor.route.text: Either balcony reaches the mirrors. Fight its patrol and pull the upper release, or use the lower garden to drain its lock. The other route is optional.

pc.victor.stranger.speaker: victor
pc.victor.stranger.text: You came to help when everyone else was leaving. I'll keep your way back clear.

pc.victor.mirrors.speaker: victor
pc.victor.mirrors.text: Aim each of the three mirrors at its sun mark. All three beams must connect to open the door.

pc.victor.wait.speaker: victor
pc.victor.wait.text: I'll hold the fountain. If one route fails, try the other.

pc.victor.done.speaker: victor
pc.victor.done.text: Go find how to stop the King. We'll hold the courtyard.

kd.walter.first.speaker: walter
kd.walter.first.text: Search the west cells. The beds are empty, but the guards are still here. Look behind those rooms.

kd.walter.marks.speaker: walter
kd.walter.marks.text: Follow the old service marks behind the empty cells. They lead through a false wall.

kd.walter.lift.speaker: walter
kd.walter.lift.text: Free the prisoners, then grip the winch handle on the lift. Walk around its drum to raise everyone. The old stairs have collapsed. The lift keeps running after they reach shelter.

kd.walter.ellis.speaker: walter
kd.walter.ellis.text: Ellis helped with the King's research. He escaped to Frostfell. Find him; he may know how to stop this.

kd.walter.unknown.speaker: walter
kd.walter.unknown.text: I don't know more. Ellis knows the experiments better than I do.

kd.walter.fallen.speaker: walter
kd.walter.fallen.text: The Fallen guards the release hall. A champion, now Hollowed. We'll wait in the upper shelter until you defeat it.

kd.sly.first.speaker: sly
kd.sly.first.text: I'm Sly. Before we leave, help me return something I stole.

kd.sly.busy.speaker: sly
kd.sly.busy.text: Walter knows the way out. Speak to him first.

kd.sly.truth.speaker: sly
kd.sly.truth.text: I stole a family locket and purple shard from a man in the hidden cells. I hoped to buy my escape.

kd.sly.quiet.speaker: sly
kd.sly.quiet.text: Once he's free, return the locket to his bundle. I'll help carry his things out.

kd.sly.open.speaker: sly
kd.sly.open.text: Return it to his bundle. I'll confess and let him decide what I owe.

kd.sly.angry.speaker: sly
kd.sly.angry.text: He keeps reaching for his missing locket. I hoped you'd help me put this right.

kd.sly.repair.speaker: sly
kd.sly.repair.text: You returned it. I'll confess. Take the shard somewhere useful.

kd.sly.quiet.reward.speaker: sly
kd.sly.quiet.reward.text: Here's the shard. I helped him onto the lift. He thanked me. I wish he knew why that hurt.

kd.sly.open.reward.speaker: sly
kd.sly.open.reward.text: He knows. He made me carry his pack, then shared his bread. Take this shard.

kd.sly.done.speaker: sly
kd.sly.done.text: I'll stay with the others. No more stealing.

rv.pattern.offer.speaker: anvil
rv.pattern.offer.text: Recover the Legion's tool-head pattern from the western stores. We need good tools to rebuild homes.

rv.pattern.later.speaker: anvil
rv.pattern.later.text: This can wait. Come back when you're ready.

rv.pattern.accepted.speaker: anvil
rv.pattern.accepted.text: Find the pattern box in the western stores, Iron Halls. Its plate offers a clue. Reach the Great Furnace before returning with the pattern.

rv.pattern.wait.speaker: anvil
rv.pattern.wait.text: Cool the pattern box in Iron Halls' western stores. Finish that half, then return here.

rv.pattern.deliver.speaker: anvil
rv.pattern.deliver.text: That's the pattern. Now we can make better tools.

rv.pattern.thanks.speaker: anvil
rv.pattern.thanks.text: The new tools are beside the forge. Here's 450 gold.

rv.supplies.offer.speaker: quartermaster
rv.supplies.offer.text: Recover food from Broken Walls' sealed western chamber. Our neighbors need it.

rv.supplies.later.speaker: quartermaster
rv.supplies.later.text: This can wait. Come back when you're ready.

rv.supplies.accepted.speaker: quartermaster
rv.supplies.accepted.text: Climb to the hoist brake in Broken Walls' western chamber. Lower the food, then bring it back here.

rv.supplies.wait.speaker: quartermaster
rv.supplies.wait.text: Free the hoist brake above the western chamber. Collect the food below, then bring it here.

rv.supplies.deliver.speaker: quartermaster
rv.supplies.deliver.text: The supplies arrived safely. Thank you.

rv.supplies.thanks.speaker: quartermaster
rv.supplies.thanks.text: The shelves are stocked. Here's 300 gold.

rv.tracks.offer.speaker: beastkeeper
rv.tracks.offer.text: Paw prints lead west from Black Woods' old grove. Check the abandoned traps and rescue both animals.

rv.tracks.later.speaker: beastkeeper
rv.tracks.later.text: They're off the main path. Help when you can safely return.

rv.tracks.accepted.speaker: beastkeeper
rv.tracks.accepted.text: Follow both trails west of the grove: low logs and roots. Free both animals, finish Black Woods, then return.

rv.tracks.wait.speaker: beastkeeper
rv.tracks.wait.text: Follow four-toed paw prints, not split hooves. Check the roots and raised cage. Your own companion isn't required.

rv.tracks.deliver.speaker: beastkeeper
rv.tracks.deliver.text: Both animals are free. I'll prepare their shelter and improve our companion care.

rv.tracks.thanks.speaker: beastkeeper
rv.tracks.thanks.text: The care shelter is ready. All equipped companions now gain 10% maximum health.

rv.keepsake.offer.speaker: thomas
rv.keepsake.offer.text: If you return home, find the little wooden bird you carved. I'd like something of ours here.

rv.keepsake.later.speaker: thomas
rv.keepsake.later.text: It can wait. I want you safe more than I want the bird.

rv.keepsake.accepted.speaker: thomas
rv.keepsake.accepted.text: Look behind our old house, southwest of the village yard—somewhere sheltered from rain. Finish Homefields before returning.

rv.keepsake.wait.speaker: thomas
rv.keepsake.wait.text: Behind our old house, southwest of the yard. Remember that awkward plant pot?

rv.keepsake.deliver.speaker: thomas
rv.keepsake.deliver.text: Still crooked. Still my favorite bird. Thank you.

rv.keepsake.thanks.speaker: thomas
rv.keepsake.thanks.text: A little piece of home. Take these coins. When this is over, carve me another.

rv.keepsake.worry.speaker: thomas
rv.keepsake.worry.text: I'm worried, and I'm proud. You brought people home. Both feelings can be true.

rv.keepsake.home.speaker: thomas
rv.keepsake.home.text: I'll mend what I can and feed the new arrivals. You're not the only stubborn one here.

rv.keepsake.reports.speaker: thomas
rv.keepsake.reports.text: People tell me how you helped them. That's the part of every story I believe.

hall.keeper.intro.speaker: riftkeeper
hall.keeper.intro.text: Five matching saved shards automatically open a training rift. Briar Town is first on your right; the others follow campaign order.

hall.keeper.welcome.speaker: riftkeeper
hall.keeper.welcome.text: Each frame shows its region, class, and saved shard count. What would you like to know?

hall.keeper.assemble.speaker: riftkeeper
hall.keeper.assemble.text: Save all five matching shards to open a portal automatically. Necromancer also requires completing Castle Duskmoor. You never need my help to assemble it.

hall.keeper.origin.speaker: riftkeeper
hall.keeper.origin.text: A Sunspire scholar threw the training rifts from the palace to save them from the Legion. They shattered across Aerth.

hall.keeper.scholar.speaker: riftkeeper
hall.keeper.scholar.text: Scattered shards could be recovered. In the Legion's hands, those fighting lessons would be lost.

hall.keeper.training.speaker: riftkeeper
hall.keeper.training.text: A mentor waits inside each rift. Complete the trial to unlock that fighting style.

hall.keeper.difference.speaker: riftkeeper
hall.keeper.difference.text: These purple rifts lead to training. The King's black Hollow Gate removes souls. They are different kinds of magic.

hall.keeper.saving.speaker: riftkeeper
hall.keeper.saving.text: Finish each level part to save its shards. Death loses only unsaved ones. In co-op, each player must collect world shards themselves.

trial.berserker.intro.speaker: mentor_berserker
trial.berserker.intro.text: Show me you can fight fiercely without losing control.

trial.berserker.lesson.speaker: mentor_berserker
trial.berserker.lesson.text: Move between attacks. Save heavy swings for clear openings.

trial.berserker.proved.speaker: mentor_berserker
trial.berserker.proved.text: The fight is over. Come speak to me.

trial.berserker.learn.speaker: mentor_berserker
trial.berserker.learn.text: You've learned the Berserker discipline. Take the exit and protect what matters.

trial.ninja.intro.speaker: mentor_ninja
trial.ninja.intro.text: Good positioning wins fights. Show me yours.

trial.ninja.lesson.speaker: mentor_ninja
trial.ninja.lesson.text: Leave attack warnings before they land. Strike from a clear angle, then move.

trial.ninja.proved.speaker: mentor_ninja
trial.ninja.proved.text: Well fought. Come speak to me.

trial.ninja.learn.speaker: mentor_ninja
trial.ninja.learn.text: You've learned the Ninja discipline. Take the exit. Keep finding openings.

trial.reaper.intro.speaker: mentor_reaper
trial.reaper.intro.text: Your scythe has reach. Use it without ignoring enemy attacks.

trial.reaper.lesson.speaker: mentor_reaper
trial.reaper.lesson.text: Fight near the edge of your reach. Strike when enemies commit to an attack.

trial.reaper.proved.speaker: mentor_reaper
trial.reaper.proved.text: The chamber is clear. Come speak to me.

trial.reaper.learn.speaker: mentor_reaper
trial.reaper.learn.text: You've learned the Reaper discipline. Take the exit. Balance power with patience.

trial.chronomancer.intro.speaker: mentor_chronomancer
trial.chronomancer.intro.text: Timing matters more than rushing. Show me you can use an opening.

trial.chronomancer.lesson.speaker: mentor_chronomancer
trial.chronomancer.lesson.text: Use enemy pauses to move or attack. Your time skills create more of those openings.

trial.chronomancer.proved.speaker: mentor_chronomancer
trial.chronomancer.proved.text: The trial is complete. Come speak to me.

trial.chronomancer.learn.speaker: mentor_chronomancer
trial.chronomancer.learn.text: You've learned the Chronomancer discipline. Take the exit and make each moment count.

trial.pirate.intro.speaker: mentor_pirate
trial.pirate.intro.text: Keep your footing when the fight gets messy. Show me.

trial.pirate.lesson.speaker: mentor_pirate
trial.pirate.lesson.text: Fire your pistol from a distance. Charge your saber when enemies get close.

trial.pirate.proved.speaker: mentor_pirate
trial.pirate.proved.text: Still standing. Come speak to me.

trial.pirate.learn.speaker: mentor_pirate
trial.pirate.learn.text: You've learned the Pirate discipline. Take the exit. Keep your footing and pick your shots.

trial.paladin.intro.speaker: mentor_paladin
trial.paladin.intro.text: Protect yourself without becoming careless. Show me you can hold your ground.

trial.paladin.lesson.speaker: mentor_paladin
trial.paladin.lesson.text: Watch enemy warnings. Leave room to dodge and use protection before a hit lands.

trial.paladin.proved.speaker: mentor_paladin
trial.paladin.proved.text: You made it. Come speak to me.

trial.paladin.learn.speaker: mentor_paladin
trial.paladin.learn.text: You've learned the Paladin discipline. Take the exit and use your strength to protect others.

trial.necromancer.intro.speaker: mentor_necromancer
trial.necromancer.intro.text: Fight with your summons. Don't let commanding them distract you from danger.

trial.necromancer.lesson.speaker: mentor_necromancer
trial.necromancer.lesson.text: Give summons room to fight. Dodge attacks aimed at you and use the openings they create.

trial.necromancer.proved.speaker: mentor_necromancer
trial.necromancer.proved.text: The trial is complete. Come speak to me.

trial.necromancer.learn.speaker: mentor_necromancer
trial.necromancer.learn.text: You've learned the Necromancer discipline. Take the exit. Command your allies carefully.

trial.pyromancer.intro.speaker: mentor_pyromancer
trial.pyromancer.intro.text: Fire is useful when you control where it goes. Clear this chamber and show me.

trial.pyromancer.lesson.speaker: mentor_pyromancer
trial.pyromancer.lesson.text: Keep moving between casts. Use your shield or blast when enemies get close.

trial.pyromancer.proved.speaker: mentor_pyromancer
trial.pyromancer.proved.text: The chamber is clear. Come finish your lesson.

trial.pyromancer.learn.speaker: mentor_pyromancer
trial.pyromancer.learn.text: You've earned the Pyromancer discipline. Take the exit. Keep your flame under control.

sc.otto.hello.speaker: otto
sc.otto.hello.text: Martin sent you? Good. Let's get you to Sunspire.

sc.otto.plan.speaker: otto
sc.otto.plan.text: Sunspire lies beyond the island cliffs. Repair this boat with a rudder, sailcloth and rope.

sc.otto.work.speaker: otto
sc.otto.work.text: Fit what you find at my workbench. I can help if you prefer.

sc.otto.rudder.speaker: otto
sc.otto.rudder.text: The rudder fits. Now we can steer.

sc.otto.rope.speaker: otto
sc.otto.rope.text: Strong rope. Just what we need.

sc.otto.routes.speaker: otto
sc.otto.routes.text: Rudder: western wreck's raised stern. Sailcloth: eastern lookout. Rope: cave below that ridge; drain it before lifting the inside latch.

sc.otto.ready.speaker: otto
sc.otto.ready.text: Avoid marked rocks and clear boarding enemies. Sheltered water halfway across lets you repair the hull and swap steering roles.

sc.otto.farewell.speaker: otto
sc.otto.farewell.text: Check the shore before departing. You may still have unfinished tasks.

sc.rose.hello.speaker: rose
sc.rose.hello.text: That wreck was my ship. Its bell should still be inside. Would you fetch it?

sc.rose.memory.speaker: rose
sc.rose.memory.text: I stayed at the wheel. The others took the small boat. I never learned where they landed.

sc.rose.wait.speaker: rose
sc.rose.wait.text: Found anything? No need to make it sound better than it is.

sc.rose.truth.speaker: rose
sc.rose.truth.text: Together. Thank you for telling me honestly. Take this Rift Shard from our deck.

sc.rose.kind.speaker: rose
sc.rose.kind.text: Some escaped. I needed that reminder. Take this Rift Shard, and stay safe at sea.

sc.rose.advice.speaker: rose
sc.rose.advice.text: Watch the clear water beside each rock. That's your route through.

sc.rose.angry.speaker: rose
sc.rose.angry.text: Straighten the crew's name board beside the wreck before the tide takes it. Then leave me alone.

sc.rose.repair.speaker: rose
sc.rose.repair.text: I heard you. I would rather see what you do next.

sc.rose.closed.speaker: rose
sc.rose.closed.text: Leave the bell on the beach if you want. Leave me in peace either way.

sl.hugh.hello.speaker: hugh
sl.hugh.hello.text: These halls hold dangerous knowledge. A locked door didn't keep the Legion out.

sl.hugh.need.speaker: hugh
sl.hugh.need.text: You helped our people. Keeping this door shut won't protect them now.

sl.hugh.cold.speaker: hugh
sl.hugh.cold.text: Demanding dangerous knowledge won't earn my trust.

sl.hugh.wait.speaker: hugh
sl.hugh.wait.text: The service workers know how to get past broken doors without my permission.

sl.hugh.records.speaker: hugh
sl.hugh.records.text: Move the loose pages onto the dry desk in the east records room, away from the broken window.

sl.hugh.open.speaker: hugh
sl.hugh.open.text: Follow the central aisle through the reading hall. The guardian beyond still attacks anyone who approaches.

sl.hugh.orb.speaker: hugh
sl.hugh.orb.text: The orb allows one clear question. Ask what you came to learn.

sl.simon.hello.speaker: simon
sl.simon.hello.text: Welcome to the restricted shelves. The Legion has made a mess of our rules.

sl.simon.shelf.speaker: simon
sl.simon.shelf.text: A shard is across that gap. Turn the first crank, cross the shelves, then turn the second crank on the far landing.

sl.simon.hint.speaker: simon
sl.simon.hint.text: The gold edges mark where the shelves will unfold. If you fall, use the lower shelves to get back and try again.

sl.simon.legion.speaker: simon
sl.simon.legion.text: The Legion wants our maps and spells. We should have shared this knowledge before they seized it.

sl.simon.frames.speaker: simon
sl.simon.frames.text: A senior scholar threw the training rifts from Sunspire to save them. Their scattered shards can restore the lessons inside.

sl.simon.stands.speaker: simon
sl.simon.stands.text: Activate one archive seal at a time. Defeat its guards and secure the stand before the gold marks fade. Failed attempts can be retried.

sl.simon.reward.speaker: simon
sl.simon.reward.text: Save the records, then collect the shard inside the archive seal.

dr.simon.nest.speaker: simon
dr.simon.nest.text: A young dragon is trapped on the western terraces. Follow the ledge beyond the empty displays.

dr.simon.safe.speaker: simon
dr.simon.safe.text: Get spare beams and dried meat from the lower supply ledge. Brace the cracked frame before turning the winch, then climb up and release the net.

dr.simon.joke.speaker: simon
dr.simon.joke.text: It ate part of the rulebook. The staff liked that.

dr.simon.free.speaker: simon
dr.simon.free.text: The dragon trusts you. Give it room and finish the reading halls together. The Beastkeeper can help afterward.

ff.heath.first.speaker: heath
ff.heath.first.text: Looking for Ellis? Follow his scratched arrows uphill. The Legion is searching for him too.

ff.heath.blunt.speaker: heath
ff.heath.blunt.text: The caves are uphill. Let me help you get there safely.

ff.heath.prepare.speaker: heath
ff.heath.prepare.text: The heater coil fell out beside the crossing. Fit it in the winch, then climb toward the cave. The western ridge shelters you from the wind.

ff.heath.ellis.speaker: heath
ff.heath.ellis.text: He arrived with research papers and little food. He was afraid someone had followed him.

ff.heath.wind.speaker: heath
ff.heath.wind.text: Wait behind the rock until the hanging cloth goes slack. Or take the sheltered ridge.

ff.heath.camp.speaker: heath
ff.heath.camp.text: West of the upper trail is an explorer’s camp. I can see his survey rig above it. Those broken ledges might still hold your weight.

ff.heath.repaired.speaker: heath
ff.heath.repaired.text: The crossing is down. This small healing pad has limited charge. The cave is buried under a snow shelf. Look for the anchor above it.

ff.heath.home.speaker: heath
ff.heath.home.text: Find Ellis. I'll keep the shelter ready for your return.

ff.heath.waiting.speaker: heath
ff.heath.waiting.text: The crossing is ready. Read the marker on the broad shelf above the cave. It points to the cornice anchor.

ff.heath.aftercamp.speaker: heath
ff.heath.aftercamp.text: West of the upper trail. Follow the broken ledges above the camp. The rig’s anchor is at the top.

mc.orb.hello.speaker: sunspire_orb
mc.orb.hello.text: You have reached me. One question, freely asked. No title is needed here.

mc.orb.steady.speaker: sunspire_orb
mc.orb.steady.text: Then take that moment. Fear does not make your purpose smaller.

mc.orb.wry.speaker: sunspire_orb
mc.orb.wry.text: A short speech leaves more room for the truth.

mc.orb.souls.speaker: sunspire_orb
mc.orb.souls.text: These souls were taken through the Hollow Gate. They remain trapped in the Abyssal Void while their bodies obey the King.

mc.orb.anchor.speaker: sunspire_orb
mc.orb.anchor.text: His soul anchors the Gate's control. Defeat him to break that control. While he lives, he can keep taking people.

mc.orb.route.speaker: sunspire_orb
mc.orb.route.text: Castle Duskmoor. Remember this vision: the shore, the narrow landing, then the climb beneath the western wall. This is his hidden home.

mc.orb.farewell.speaker: sunspire_orb
mc.orb.farewell.text: You know the way. Go help the people you came to save.

mc.orb.quiet.speaker: sunspire_orb
mc.orb.quiet.text: The path has been shown. What you do with it belongs to you.

tc.abe.hello.speaker: abe
tc.abe.hello.text: You crossed safely. Good. The climb to Sunspire starts here.

tc.abe.path.speaker: abe
tc.abe.path.text: The eastern steps reach the middle ledge. The broken cargo lift is a shortcut if you want to repair it. Look for an old hydra shackle above.

tc.abe.wait.speaker: abe
tc.abe.wait.text: I'll watch the boat. Take care on the climb.

tc.abe.beast.speaker: abe
tc.abe.beast.text: The Legion chained a hydra across the climb. It attacks because the chains hurt it—not because it serves them.

tc.abe.reason.speaker: abe
tc.abe.reason.text: Free it before deciding it has to die.

tc.abe.chains.speaker: abe
tc.abe.chains.text: Inspect the old shackle on the middle ledge. Break the new neck shackles while the hydra rests. It may leave once free.

tc.abe.farewell.speaker: abe
tc.abe.farewell.text: You helped a creature that could have killed you. Remember that kindness when you reach the palace.

tc.dash.hello.speaker: dash
tc.dash.hello.text: This is my treasure claim. The stick makes it official. Probably.

tc.dash.offer.speaker: dash
tc.dash.offer.text: Help open the wreck cave and split the coins. Or beat my cliff race to keep them all.

tc.dash.help.speaker: dash
tc.dash.help.text: Brace the lower catch open, then turn the upper wheel. One person can do it.

tc.dash.race.speaker: dash
tc.dash.race.text: Touch flags 1, 2 and 3, then ring the cave bell within two minutes. Return here to retry.

tc.dash.done.speaker: dash
tc.dash.done.text: You earned those coins. That climb was worth watching.

shade.outskirts.speaker: warden_shade
shade.outskirts.text: The Legion is approaching Briar. The townspeople are doing what they can. Protect the supplies and help your neighbors prepare. Every person you help gives the town a better chance.

shade.hollow.speaker: warden_shade
shade.hollow.text: Free the canyon prisoners. Use cover when the Marksman aims.

shade.keep.speaker: warden_shade
shade.keep.text: Rescue the hidden prisoners. Their lift is the way out.

shade.frost.speaker: warden_shade
shade.frost.text: Find Ellis in the ice caves. Three officers guard the exit.

shade.ember.speaker: warden_shade
shade.ember.text: Shelter the workers, then stop the Legion's weapon line.

shade.abyss.speaker: warden_shade
shade.abyss.text: Repair the boat. Beyond the coast, a chained hydra needs your help.

shade.palace.speaker: warden_shade
shade.palace.text: Reach the knowledge orb. The palace guardian blocks your path.

shade.castle.speaker: warden_shade
shade.castle.text: Climb to the Hollow Gate. The King waits at the summit.

legacyShade: Current-canon regional guidance; original safe Briar audition reused exactly.
